verdict.rationale: A probe confirms Pilot serves a working llms.txt at https://pilot.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200) with structured entity/category metadata, directly satisfying the story that an agent can be pointed at llms.txt. However, other agent-oriented doc formats (docs.md, openapi.json) return 404, and the llms.txt content itself is minimal (just a few lines of categorization, not rich agent-oriented documentation). Missing for 10: deeper llms.txt content (links to docs, structured Q&A), additional machine-readable docs formats, and any independent confirmation of agent usage of this file.
